scope: Pre-ship check by 5 read-only agents (design, mobile, states, journey, launch). Duplicates across agents merged; one false positive dropped (rate-limit 429 bodies are already JSON — src/rate-limit.js returns res.json).
notes: Items under the FEATURE_DOCS flag (Drive, Dashboard, PlanDocuments/DocumentList) ship switched off; they are marked docsFlag: true.
The on-site record page (#/plans/<id>/<code>) has no entry point by design — the app is now used for office preparation only. Items about it are marked recordPage: true.

issues.issue: newPlan (and deleting the active plan) never resets planStatus, so shops already added stay '✓ อยู่ในแผน' with button/drag/'a' blocked and cannot be filed into the new plan until a new search.
issues.fix: setPlanStatus({}) in newPlan and when refreshPlans drops the active plan.

issues.issue: Below 899px the step nav is a non-wrapping row of nowrap buttons (~440px for 4 steps) inside a ~323px bar with overflow: visible, so the whole page scrolls sideways on 375px phones.
issues.fix: On narrow screens let the nav wrap or scroll in its own overflow-x strip, stack icon above label, drop nowrap.

issues.issue: The narrow-screen rules target `.app-sidebar nav a` (lines 311, 319) but Sidebar renders <button>, so the dot hide and ≤420px compaction never apply.
issues.fix: Use `.app-sidebar nav :is(a, button)`.

issues.issue: ☐/☑ `.check` toggles have no padding inside the zoomed A4 sheet; at 375px they are ~6–8px tap targets.
issues.fix: Enlarge the hit area on coarse pointers with a transparent ::after inset:-12px.

issues.issue: The 'เลือกรายชื่อ' `.pick` pill sits inside the zoomed sheet and shrinks to ~10px on phones.
issues.fix: Counter-scale it or give it min-height 44px on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: `button.link` actions (ลบ, เอาออก, เปลี่ยนชื่อ, ดาวน์โหลด) are ~24px tall and packed without a gap, so destructive taps are easy to hit by mistake.
issues.fix: min-height 44px + padding on coarse pointers and gap between actions.

issues.issue: After an autosave fails, save='failed' with dirty=true re-arms the 1s timer forever: a 401 re-prompts every second, a 409 re-PUTs every second.
issues.fix: Do not auto-schedule when save === 'failed'; retry on next edit or tap.

issues.issue: The error banner always offers 'โหลดของล่าสุด' / 'บันทึกทับ'; after a plain network/export error 'โหลดของล่าสุด' throws away unsaved typing. No role=alert.
issues.fix: Show conflict buttons only for StaleRecordError, otherwise 'ลองใหม่'; add role=alert.

issues.issue: get() parses JSON unguarded and reads only data.message: a proxy/Vercel HTML 502/504 shows an English JSON SyntaxError, and the server's `error` field (401 in header mode) is lost.
issues.fix: response.json().catch(() => ({})) and throw data.message || data.error || Thai fallback with HTTP status.

issues.issue: 'ร้านถัดไป' navigates without flushing and App renders RecordForm without a key, so the last edit can be lost or shop A's draft PUT to shop B.
issues.fix: await flush() before navigating; render RecordForm with key={planId+'/'+newCode}.

issues.issue: Nothing links to the on-site record page #/plans/<id>/<code>; RecordForm, photos, signatures and record exports are reachable only by typing the URL.
issues.fix: Decide: re-add a per-row entry, or treat the record page as out of scope for this release (current direction: office-prep only).
issues.status: removed — on-site record page deleted at the user's request; old #/plans/… links redirect to จัดแผน

issues.issue: ensureActivePlan reads activePlan from the render closure; two quick adds before createPlan resolves create two plans, and server createPlan picks the next letter non-atomically (src/plans.js:136).
issues.fix: Keep the in-flight create promise in a ref and await it.

issues.issue: When addToPlan returns added: [] (already in plan, FDA detail failed) the card shows '+ ใส่แผน (ลองใหม่)' and drops failed[].message.
issues.fix: Show failed[0].message; treat 'already in plan' as added.

issues.issue: Every 401 becomes PasscodeError; in AUTH_MODE=header the user gets a pointless passcode prompt and never sees 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบผ่านระบบของสภาฯ'.
issues.fix: Mark passcode refusals with code:'PASSCODE' on the server and only prompt for those; otherwise show the server message.

issues.issue: The date input PATCHes on every change and disables itself while saving; typing a year by keyboard sends partial years (0002) → 400 and loses focus mid-typing.
issues.fix: Save only on a complete 4-digit year (or on blur); do not disable while saving.

issues.issue: 'อัปเดตข้อมูลจาก อย.' rebuilds pharmacists and wipes licence numbers the officer picked or typed by hand.
issues.fix: Keep licenceNo/licenceSource for same-name pharmacists when the old source was manual.

issues.issue: Deleting a plan leaves its records/photos/documents and the letter is reused, so a new plan A inherits old plan A's records, and another device still pointing at A files into the new plan.
issues.fix: Delete the plan's records and blobs with it, or never reuse a deleted letter.
issues.status: partly fixed — a deleted plan's letter is not reused while its documents remain; the documents themselves are kept

issues.issue: Object URLs are revoked right after link.click() (also records-api.js:107); Safari/iPadOS can cancel the download.
issues.fix: Append the link, click, and revoke after a 10s timeout like form.html.

issues.issue: Leaving via '← แผนการตรวจ' or the sidebar unmounts without flushing; the last second of typing/signing is lost.
issues.fix: Flush on unmount / before navigating.

issues.issue: Load failure shows a bare error with no retry or role=alert; loading text has no role=status.
issues.fix: load() function + 'ลองใหม่' button, role=alert / role=status.

issues.issue: สร้าง PDF/Word have no busy state; repeated taps start duplicate Chromium renders and burn the render rate limit.
issues.fix: Track exporting, disable both buttons, label 'กำลังสร้าง…'.

issues.issue: Plan Word/PDF export has no busy flag or progress label and can be clicked repeatedly.
issues.fix: Wrap exportPlan in busy and show 'กำลังส่งออก…'.

issues.issue: While a plan loads (or after it fails) the step says 'เลือกแผน…' as if none were selected; no loading state, no retry, previous plan lingers on switch.
issues.fix: Clear on planId change, show loading, show 'ลองใหม่' on failure.

issues.issue: downloadExport ignores the error body, so the Thai 409/429/404 message becomes 'ส่งออกไม่สำเร็จ (HTTP n)'.
issues.fix: Read JSON body and throw data.message || data.error.

issues.issue: A failed preview is cached; toggling it again re-shows the error and never refetches. Preview error has no role=alert or retry.
issues.fix: Refetch when cached status is 'error'; add role=alert + retry.

issues.issue: A failed thumbnail fetch leaves 'กำลังโหลด...' forever.
issues.fix: Track failure and show 'โหลดรูปไม่สำเร็จ'.

issues.issue: A failed document preview fetch leaves 'กำลังโหลด...' forever.
issues.fix: Track failure and show 'โหลดไม่สำเร็จ'.

issues.issue: Promise.all over records: one failing shop replaces the whole step with an error that has no retry.
issues.fix: Promise.allSettled per shop + retry button.

issues.issue: Folder listing failure disables the toolbar with no retry except reloading the page.
issues.fix: Add 'ลองใหม่' calling load().

issues.issue: If the area list fails to load, province select stays disabled for the session with no retry.
issues.fix: Retry button that re-runs fetchAreas().

issues.issue: `.link-btn` (ดึงข้อมูลใหม่, ล้างตัวกรอง) is ~18px tall.
issues.fix: padding + min-height 44px on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: `.find-licence` pills are ~22px tall and stacked tightly.
issues.fix: min-height 36–44px on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: `.licence-pick` / `.licence-missing` are ~20px tall — important action, tiny target.
issues.fix: min-height 44px in the ≤700px card layout.

issues.issue: Result-card `.ghost` buttons are ~30px; the 40px bump only applies ≤560px so iPad portrait gets the small size.
issues.fix: min-height 44px under pointer: coarse.

issues.issue: `.stats-bar` filters are ~28px and stacked with no gap.
issues.fix: min-height 44px on coarse pointers + gap.

issues.issue: '+ แผนใหม่' in the fixed cart is ~30px (smaller still on phones).
issues.fix: min-height 44px for cart button and select on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: Route drag handle is only 32px wide, hard to grab on a phone.
issues.fix: min-width 44px.

issues.issue: The page-ground gradient literal is copied in app.css:287, theme.css:116 and index.css:64.
issues.fix: Add --ground token in theme.css and reference it in all three.

issues.issue: Inputs use var(--background) (grey) in app.css but var(--card) (white) in theme.css, so text fields look different per step (also 473, 583, 761).
issues.fix: One input surface token used everywhere.

issues.issue: The on-screen `.pick` chip uses font-family 'Inter', which is not loaded and not in the design system (Kanit).
issues.fix: Use the theme font (inherit from toolbar).

issues.issue: Radii are hard-coded (10px ×13, 1rem ×15, .75rem/12px/.6rem/6px) instead of the --radius scale.
issues.fix: Add --radius-control / --radius-card tokens and reference them.

issues.issue: Status badge uses arbitrary bg-[var(--success-bg)] classes because status tokens are not in @theme.
issues.fix: Expose success/danger colours in @theme inline (index.css) and use bg-success etc.

issues.issue: Card hover shadow hard-codes the olive brand as rgba(115,115,0,.10).
issues.fix: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 10%, transparent) or a --shadow-hover token.

issues.issue: Cart/toast shadows hard-code rgba(46,46,0,…) in two places (648, 903).
issues.fix: Add a --shadow-float token.

issues.issue: Cart select hard-codes #fff and rgba(255,255,255,.16) instead of --primary-foreground.
issues.fix: Use var(--primary-foreground) / color-mix.

issues.issue: First-screen sub-line explains the mechanism (live FDA data, then filter) instead of what the tool does for officers.
issues.fix: One purpose sentence: ค้นหาร้านยาที่ได้รับอนุญาตจาก อย. จัดแผนออกตรวจ และกรอกบันทึกการตรวจได้ในที่เดียว.

issues.issue: README says the UI has no router / is one screen; it now has hash routes and a step wizard.
issues.fix: Rewrite the Web UI intro.

issues.issue: README lines 281–310 describe the old static index.html (and opening it from disk), not the current Vite build.
issues.fix: Rewrite or remove that section.

issues.issue: markInspected only runs with a planId in the handoff, which the search card never passes; nothing in the live journey marks a shop 'done'.
issues.fix: Pass planId/newCode when the shop is in the active plan, or remove the dead path.

issues.issue: Record page back link #/plans goes to the active cart plan, not the record's own plan.
issues.fix: Switch the active plan to planId before redirecting.
issues.status: removed — record page deleted; #/plans redirects to จัดแผน

issues.issue: Empty states say 'เลือกแผนจากแถบด้านบน' (also PlanRoute.jsx:176) but the plan cart is bottom-right.
issues.fix: Say 'แถบมุมขวาล่าง'.

issues.issue: getPlan and getRecord each have their own withPasscode in Promise.all → two passcode prompts on a fresh tab.
issues.fix: One withPasscode around Promise.all.
issues.status: fixed — shared withPasscode now asks once for parallel 401s

issues.issue: Photo (and DocumentList) API calls skip withPasscode; a 401 shows an error with no prompt.
issues.fix: Wrap calls in withPasscode.

issues.issue: กรอกฟอร์ม handoff uses one shared localStorage key; two quick taps give the first tab the second shop and the second tab nothing.
issues.fix: Unique key per handoff passed in the form URL.

issues.issue: File input not disabled during upload (also DocumentList.jsx:134); a second pick runs a parallel loop.
issues.fix: disabled={busy} on both inputs.

issues.issue: Upload errors have no role=alert (also DocumentList.jsx:138).
issues.fix: Add role=alert.

issues.issue: Stats load failure has no retry.
issues.fix: Add 'ลองใหม่'.

issues.issue: Map step load failure has no retry.
issues.fix: load() + 'ลองใหม่'.

issues.issue: #status (the only progress/error channel for downloads) has no aria-live.
issues.fix: role=status aria-live=polite.

issues.issue: Print handler's bare catch hides the reason (429, popup blocked, server down).
issues.fix: Include err.message in the status text.

issues.issue: Results/error output has no aria-live.
issues.fix: aria-live=polite on output, role=alert on errors.

issues.issue: Drive file/folder targets are 32px.
issues.fix: min-height 44px on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: Sidebar nav buttons are ~38px tall.
issues.fix: min-height 44px under 899px / coarse pointers.

issues.issue: Pharmacist-search copy/source pills ~22px; submit/clear ~32px.
issues.fix: Raise to 36–44px on coarse pointers.

issues.issue: `.btn-icon` fixed at 38×38px.
Officer-picker rows are ~28px tall.
issues.fix: padding 10px 0; min-height 44px.

issues.issue: Form toolbar buttons ~38px tall.
issues.fix: min-height 44px.

issues.issue: 'แนบท้าย PDF' checkbox row is tiny and sits right above ลบรูป.
issues.fix: min-height 44px, larger checkbox.

issues.issue: `.stats` minmax(260px, 1fr) overflows at 320px viewports.
issues.fix: minmax(min(260px, 100%), 1fr).

issues.issue: `.form-frame` min-height 560px is taller than a landscape phone; nested scroll and the cart covers its bottom.

issues.issue: Cart option colour #111827 repeats --foreground.
issues.fix: var(--foreground).

issues.issue: Cart count and .planbar-new (669) use #fff.
issues.fix: var(--primary-foreground).

issues.issue: Toast hard-codes #fff and its own shadow.
issues.fix: --primary-foreground + shared shadow token.

issues.issue: form-frame, route-map (720), signature canvas (622) and kbd (895) use background #fff.

issues.issue: min(1.5rem, 24px) repeated 3× (82, 310, 364).
issues.fix: --radius-panel token.

issues.issue: Dashboard series use raw --olive-700/400 instead of --chart-* tokens.
issues.fix: Point at --chart-1 and a second chart token.

issues.issue: Scrollbar colours hard-coded hex (344–345).
issues.fix: color-mix of --muted-foreground.

issues.issue: `.radial-bg` hard-codes #ffffff / #f5f5f5.
issues.fix: var(--card) / var(--background).

issues.issue: Overflow warning red #b00020 (also 1441) is off-palette.
issues.fix: Use --danger-fg on screen.

issues.issue: Chip shadow and dialog backdrop (596) are untokenised.

issues.issue: Inline style marginTop 10px on CopyButton.
issues.fix: Class in app.css.

issues.issue: Inline skeleton widths (29–31).
issues.fix: Modifier classes in app.css.

issues.issue: Ink '#111' does not match --foreground.
